credit_metrics.text: EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, but operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} as the weakening of the krone against the dollar weighed on the result.

Total debt increased by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, leaving gross leverage broadly unchanged at {{gross_leverage@FY2024}}.
Interest coverage weakened by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median.
FFO grew by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}, but FFO to debt slipped by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} as debt rose faster than cash generation.
Free cash flow increased by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}}, lifting FCF to debt by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}, above the peer median.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity increased by the same {{cash_liquidity.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity@FY2024}}.
Cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, so a growing part of the cash is customer prepayments.
The Board intends to propose a profit distribution per share, subject to approval from debt instrument holders, and financing terms for upcoming aircraft deliveries improved.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, helped by the Widerøe acquisition and a modest increase of a single aircraft from Boeing delivery delays.
The fuel share of costs fell by {{fuel_share_of_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median.
In FY2023 the group carried {{passengers@FY2023}} passengers on {{ask@FY2023}} available seat kilometres, with a load factor of {{load_factor@FY2023}} and a fleet of {{fleet@FY2023}} aircraft.
Unit economics in FY2023 showed RASK of {{rask@FY2023}} against CASK of {{cask@FY2023}}, with CASK ex-fuel at {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2023}}.
Collective bargaining agreements concluded during the year raised personnel cost across several markets while reducing the risk of industrial action.

peer_positioning.text: Norwegian sits in the middle of the low-cost group on EBITDA margin ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), net leverage ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}), interest coverage ({{interest_coverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}) and FFO to debt ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

Gross leverage is the lowest of the group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}), and FCF to debt is the strongest ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}), at {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}} against a peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2024}}.
Capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}, while cash liquidity to revenue ranks {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}.
Advance ticket cover is the lowest of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2024}}), at {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} against a peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2024}}.

snapshot.text: Norwegian Air Shuttle, a low-cost carrier that completed the acquisition of Widerøe at the start of FY2024, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}}.
The EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, while net leverage was stable at {{net_leverage@FY2024}}.
The point to watch is liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, the weakest of the low-cost peers.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, the weakest of the low-cost peers, even as cash and cash-like investments rose to {{cash_like@FY2024}}.
Margins: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, and operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}}.

Debt: total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}}, taking FFO to debt down by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} and interest coverage down to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2024}}, and contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}.
